## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## What
Create or update plugins/dso/scripts/bridge/README.md documenting the test suite so future contributors know which tests to update when adding a bridge feature.

## Acceptance Criteria
- File: plugins/dso/scripts/bridge/README.md (create if absent)
- Document the test file layout:
  - test_bridge_outbound.py: outbound bridge unit tests (cursor, event parsing, filter, handlers)
  - test_bridge_inbound.py: inbound bridge unit tests (ADF helper, field mapping)
  - test_bridge_inbound_field_coverage.py: inbound field coverage integration tests
  - test_bridge_inbound_integration.py: inbound full pipeline integration tests
  - test_bridge_failure_injection.py / test_bridge_roundtrip.py: round-trip + failure-injection matrix
- Document the 4 failure-injection test names and which fix each covers (cursor, env_id, ADF isinstance, null-assignee)
- Document how to run the bridge test suite: command to run just bridge tests
- Maximum 40 lines; avoid doc bloat

## Files to Modify / Create
- plugins/dso/scripts/bridge/README.md (new or update)
